author: @fl0rianr

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. POST /v1/load now returns a 400 for on-demand models, which is an additional rejection on top of the existing behavior — no previously-working request will fail that previously succeeded. The on-demand label is purely additive in server_models.json. API docs in docs/api/lemonade.md and docs/api/openai.md are updated to reflect the new behavior.
evidence.documentation: API docs are updated in both docs/api/lemonade.md (load endpoint restrictions and new error) and docs/api/openai.md (new Execution labels table documenting "on-demand"). The documentation accurately reflects the code behavior. The CodeRabbit suggestion to also document a collection.router exception was correctly dismissed by the author as unnecessary.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The commit changes user-visible behavior on two surfaces: POST /v1/load now returns a 400 for models labeled "on-demand", and the GUI hides the Load/Unload button for on-demand models while showing a Download button instead. The tray UI also excludes on-demand models from the downloaded list. No human was observed exercising either surface before merge.
evidence.post_approval_commits: The final commit (02fa368) that fully replaced the upscaling check with the on-demand label check was approved before merge. No commits were added after the approval at 2026-11-05T13:58:36Z.
evidence.review: PR #4047 received one substantive human review from @bitgamma, who has subject area expertise in recipes, new models, and benchmarking. @bitgamma approved at 2026-11-05T13:58:36Z. CodeRabbit raised several findings (upscaler alias resolution, router exception in docs, error message granularity) — the author addressed all of them: alias resolution was dismissed as out-of-scope (separate issue #4048 created), the router exception was dismissed as a virtual edge case, and the upscaler-specific error message was simplified to a generic one per @bitgamma's suggestion. The approach evolved iteratively from an initial "upscaling" label check to a general "on-demand" label, which @bitgamma reviewed and approved. No post-approval commits were added.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change restricts loading behavior and does not introduce new code execution paths, credential handling, network calls, or permission broadening.
evidence.tests: No new tests were added. The change affects the /v1/load endpoint (C++), the tray UI (C++), and two React components (TypeScript). The new isOnDemandModelInfo() function and the label-based check in load.cpp and router.cpp have no test coverage. This is a correctness fix, not a feature, so the absence of tests is a minor gap rather than a blocker.

maintainer_todos.text: Send a POST /v1/load request with a known upscaler model name and verify the response is a 400 error instead of proceeding with the load.

subject: fix(images): prevent loading on-demand upscalers (#4047)
summary: Prevents on-demand upscaler models from being loaded through POST /v1/load by introducing a new "on-demand" execution label, with corresponding GUI exclusions and documentation.
verdict_reason: The /v1/load endpoint and GUI are user-reachable surfaces that change behavior but were not exercised by any human before merge.
